subject.title: [Bug]: browser upload/file chooser flow is flaky and can misreport stale-click failures as browser control timeouts

question: Should Browser upload keep paths-only arming as a supported default flow, or should agent/tool usage be moved toward same-request upload-with-trigger behavior for dynamic pages?
rationale: Both paths-only arming and same-request targeted upload are currently supported, and changing the default improves reliability but affects callers that rely on delayed triggering.

options.title: Prefer atomic upload while preserving arming
options.body: Keep paths-only arming available, but steer agent/tool docs and tests toward same-request `ref`/`inputRef`/`element` upload and fix the upload-hook timeout budget.

options.title: Retire paths-only arming
options.body: Require a trigger or direct input target for uploads and document the migration for callers that currently arm before a later click.

options.title: Document current behavior only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document stale-ref recovery and targeted-upload workarounds, accepting the remaining flake.

recommendation.title: Prefer atomic upload while preserving arming
recommendation.body: Keep paths-only arming available, but steer agent/tool docs and tests toward same-request `ref`/`inputRef`/`element` upload and fix the upload-hook timeout budget.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current and historical ownership signal for the Browser upload/client surface points to steipete.
